faq_heading: Homes near Chantrell Creek Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Chantrell Creek Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Chantrell Creek Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Chantrell Creek Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Chantrell Creek Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Elgin Park Secondary (0.6 km south-west), Crescent Park Elementary (1.8 km west) and Laronde Elementary (1.8 km south-west).

Chantrell Creek Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 2575 137 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Chantrell Creek Elementary.
How the Chantrell Creek Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Chantrell Creek Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Chantrell Creek Elementary

10 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Chantrell Creek Elementary in a straight line (8 elementary, 2 secondary; 1 independent). The closest is Elgin Park Secondary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is H T Thrift Elementary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Crescent Park Elementary (1.8 km); the nearest independent school is Star of the Sea (2.7 km). Other elementary schools close by: Crescent Park Elementary (1.8 km west), Laronde Elementary (1.8 km south-west), Ray Shepherd Elementary (1.8 km south), Semiahmoo Trail Elementary (2.0 km north-east), Bayridge Elementary (2.0 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Crescent Park Elementary, 1.8 km west of Chantrell Creek Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Chantrell Creek Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Chantrell Creek Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Chantrell Creek Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Look at Crescent Park Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 1.8 km west of Chantrell Creek Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
